79639.subject: DLT Pilot Regime: Unbundle First, Rebundle Better
79639.body:
Blockchain Short Stories

Автор: Ivica Aračić


Автор: Ivica Aračić

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/dlt-pilot-regime-unbundle-first-rebundle-better-ivica-ara%C4%8Di%C4%87-1sw1e?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3Bz2%2FxP6LDTT6lriAtU6LFVQ%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=35Cdmjd_xNhYs1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~muf4to7h~oy-null-null&eid=fz96fz-muf4to7h-oy
  
One of interesting questions around the DLT Pilot Regime is what is actually gained by opening up traditional market infrastructure roles. At first sight, the argument against doing so is compelling: Established infrastructures benefit from scale, connectivity, operational maturity and an existing customer base. Splitting functions across different providers can introduce fragmentation, additional interfaces and new coordination costs. And even where functions are opened up, there is a reasonable expectation that some of them will eventually bundle again. Efficiency, scale and customer convenience tend to pull in that direction. So why open the structure at all? IMO, the main benefit is contestability. The DLT Pilot Regime is interesting not because unbundling is inherently desirable, but because it creates room to question whether the existing allocation and combination of market infrastructure functions is still optimal when the underlying technology changes. DLT potentially changes some of the assumptions on which today's structures were built. Functions can be specialized differently. New participants can enter individual parts of the value chain. Roles that are separate today may be combined in new ways. The DLT TSS is a good example: trading and settlement, traditionally separated, can be brought together within one infrastructure. What matters is that the market has an opportunity to test different constellations on the new technology. Without contestability, there is a risk that new technology simply gets inserted underneath an existing market structure without seriously questioning whether that structure is still the best one. With contestability, different configurations can compete and the market can discover better structures ultimately delivering more value than status-quo solutions.
Продовжити читати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/dlt-pilot-regime-unbundle-first-rebundle-better-ivica-ara%C4%8Di%C4%87-1sw1e?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3Bz2%2FxP6LDTT6lriAtU6LFVQ%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=35Cdmjd_xNhYs1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-newsletter_content_preview_text-0-readmore_button_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-newsletter_content_preview_text-0-readmore_button_-null-fz96fz~muf4to7h~oy-null-null&eid=fz96fz-muf4

79635.subject: Zcash's ZEC Hits $1,600, a 10-Year High
79635.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

* **[Zcash](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/zcash-clears-1-600-after-21shares-launches-european-etp)**[ cleared $1,600 for the first time since 2016 after 21Shares listed a physically backed ZEC ETP in Paris and Amsterdam.](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/zcash-clears-1-600-after-21shares-launches-european-etp)

* **[The Cosmos Hub](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/cosmos-hub-restarts-1-23-million-atom-moved-from-neutron-attacker-wallet)**[ restarted after a 24-hour, 48-minute halt, and the restart moved 1.23 million ATOM out of the attacker's wallet.](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/cosmos-hub-restarts-1-23-million-atom-moved-from-neutron-attacker-wallet)

* **[Blockchain.com and NYSE](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/blockchain-com-and-nyse-explore-24-7-tokenized-stock-trading)**[ agreed to explore round-the-clock trading of tokenized U.S. stocks through NYSE's planned digital venue.](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/blockchain-com-and-nyse-explore-24-7-tokenized-stock-trading)

* **[Ondo](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/ondo-opens-in-kind-minting-for-tokenized-us-stocks)**[ opened in-kind minting for tokenized U.S. stocks, letting approved institutions swap shares held at Alpaca for tokens.](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/ondo-opens-in-kind-minting-for-tokenized-us-stocks)

* **[Galaxy](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/galaxy-adds-100-million-of-susds-to-treasury-approves-it-as-loan-collateral)**[ put $100 million of sUSDS in its treasury and approved the yield-bearing stablecoin as loan collateral.](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/galaxy-adds-100-million-of-susds-to-treasury-approves-it-as-loan-collateral)

Zcash traded above $1,500 this week after 21Shares listed Europe's first ZEC exchange-traded product on Euronext.

The ETP trades in Paris and Amsterdam under the ticker ZCASH at a 2.5% management fee, and it landed in a market already running. ZEC is up more than 70% over 30 days and roughly 2,500% over the past year, climbing from 82nd to seventh by market cap. It's the second wrapper in a month. Grayscale converted its Zcash Trust into a spot ETF on NYSE Arca in August after the SEC signed off on Aug. 24, and that fund pulled in $32.8M on Monday to reach $979M.

The groundwork went in earlier. The SEC closed its Zcash review in January without recommending enforcement. Cypherpunk Technologies, the Winklevoss-backed treasury company, now holds 323,394 ZEC, or 1.92% of circulating supply, at an average cost of $341.83. Shielded transactions hit 62,379 last week, the most since 2022.

Getting here was ugly in places. On May 29, security researcher Taylor Hornby found a soundness flaw in the Orchard pool that could have let an attacker mint counterfeit ZEC undetected. It had been live since Orchard activated in May 2022. Developers shipped an emergency patch on June 1 and hard-forked on June 3, and Shielded Labs disclosed the bug publicly on June 5. ZEC dropped 3
